sources: https://www.cityofpittsfieldil.gov/page/pittsfield-city-lake (City of Pittsfield; read live with the headless browser, desktop Chrome UA, 2026-11-20): 'Pittsfield City Lake Campground operates on a first-come, first-served basis- no reservations are accepted. The campground offers 65 sites equipped with electric (50/30/20 amp) and water hookups, each featuring a concrete pad. These sites are available for both RVs and tents; however, tent camping on these sites is charged the same rate as RVs. Campers are welcome to arrive anytime. A park ranger is onsite and will come around each morning and evening to collect payment. Payments can also be made at the drop box located by the soccer field.' ... 'The 241-acre lake is located within a 480-acre park. The camping area is equipped with non-potable water hookups, electrical hookups, lighted areas, and a trailer dumping station.' Camping Fees: 'RV - Water & Electric Hook Up Daily Fee* $20; RV - Water & Electric Hook Up Monthly (30 day) Fee* $500; Primitive Camping Daily Fee $5'; '*Amps available at the RV lake sites are 50/30/20. The cost to set a tent on an RV pad is $20 per day. All additional tents on the same RV pad is $5 each.' Phone 217-285-4484.
Same text on the old URL in Wayback capture https://web.archive.org/web/20260609141316/https://www.pittsfieldil.org/page/pittsfield-city-lake (2026-06-09)

Esri World_Imagery (39.6316,-90.7493, 200 m and 550 m half-width, read 2026-11-20): one teardrop loop of ~35 herringbone pads on a wooded point; east-row pads ~35-65 m from the lake through continuous woods on a slope, north tip ~45 m through woods; no other camping loop visible in the park. Pin ~210 m SW of the loop centroid (under 250 m, no move).

sites.source: https://www.cityofpittsfieldil.gov/page/pittsfield-city-lake (read 2026-11-20): 'The campground offers 65 sites equipped with electric (50/30/20 amp) and water hookups, each featuring a concrete pad.' The stored 33 sites / 40-ft max came from an aggregator (campendium, per inclusion_evidence); the city states no length, so max_rig_ft is cleared.

booking.source: https://www.cityofpittsfieldil.gov/page/pittsfield-city-lake (read 2026-11-20): 'operates on a first-come, first-served basis- no reservations are accepted'

values.note: RV water and electric site $20 a day, $500 for 30 days; primitive camping $5 a day. A tent on an RV pad pays the RV rate, each added tent $5. A ranger collects mornings and evenings; drop box by the soccer field.

note: City of Pittsfield campground on a 241-acre city lake in a 480-acre park. Concrete pads with fire pits; the site water hookups are non-potable. RV sites not confirmed on the water. --Claude
